subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Resource Nationalism
description: A micro-lesson that makes Resource Nationalism usable.

hook.text: Bolivia nationalizes its lithium mines. Foreign firms that invested billions are forced out with little compensation.

buildup.text: Resource nationalism is when governments assert control over natural resources, often seizing foreign-owned operations.

discovery.text: Between 2006 and 2023, over 30 countries increased state control over oil, gas, minerals, or rare earth resources.

twist.text: As demand for lithium, cobalt, and rare earths grows, resource-rich countries gain enormous geopolitical leverage.

climax.text: Companies investing in resource-rich nations must plan for the possibility that the rules will change mid-game.

punchline.text: Invest billions in mines. Government takes them. New rules.

quiz.question: What is resource nationalism?
options: Governments asserting control over natural resources from foreign owners
Countries trading resources freely on open markets
